meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任意文本中的认知模式与思维指纹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想了解自己或他人的思考方式和认知风格
copy.tagline_en: Analyze cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand the thinking style and cognitive signature behind any text

howto.what: Claude 会读取你给的文本,按 12 个认知维度各打 1–10 分并附文本证据与置信度,再输出一份 DHDNA 认知画像:维度分数、6 组张力图、主导与影子模式、推理拓扑、决策指纹、叙述总结和关键引用。
howto.when: 当你要求分析某人怎么思考、解析写作或说话风格、比较两人的思维方式,或提到「thinking pattern」「DHDNA」等词时触发。

say.note: 输出 12 维度分数与画像

howto.what_en: Claude reads your text, scores 12 cognitive dimensions 1–10 with cited evidence and confidence, then outputs a DHDNA profile: scores, tension map, dominant/shadow patterns, reasoning topology, decision fingerprint, synthesis and key quotes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask how someone thinks, want to profile writing or speech patterns, compare two people's thinking styles, or say "thinking pattern", "cognitive profile" or "DHDNA".

say_en.text: Analyze how the author of this text thinks.
say_en.note: Outputs 12 dimension scores and a profile.

say_en.text: Give me a DHDNA cognitive profile of this text.
say_en.note: Scores each dimension with cited evidence.

say_en.text: Compare the thinking styles in these two texts.
